notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked; simulated R0; model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware run and no MHS-Device level claimed). The card's entry symbol is the environment configuration class nav_tasks.configs.env_cfg_base:NavTasksDepthNavEnvCfg (env_cfg_base.py:394), while the registered environment is isaaclab.envs:ManagerBasedRLEnv (configs/__init__.py:10-32), which lies outside the clone; the native symbol is therefore the configuration class the gate checks. Isaac Sim 4.5, Isaac Lab 2.1 and the git-lfs policy and terrain assets were never installed or run, so the sim backend (gymnasium.make of the DEV task) was not run. The fake backend is a pure-Python kinematic SE2 stand-in (F0, no dynamics or contacts): its action is the three-value [vx, vy, omega] command and its observation is the planar pose [x, y, yaw]. NOT COVERED: the full upstream policy observation vector, including the embedded depth image, joint positions and velocities and goal commands; the ANYmal D low-level locomotion policy; the upstream reward terms; the proportional timeout, goal_reached and base/leg contact terminations; and the vectorized DEV environment (num_envs 2), because the fake serves one unbatched environment. These reductions are in fidelity.gaps. Warnings are explained: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 is expected (the seed only sets the next reset); the four G7.MAYBE_ABSENT warnings for action_space, observation_space, reset and step are expected because the native class is a configuration class whose ManagerBasedRLEnvCfg base lies outside the clone and the fake implements the Gymnasium environment interface; the four G8.NO_UNIT warnings are the bridge-derived integer and action inputs; G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE is truthful because NavigationSE2ActionCfg has clip_mode none and no scale or offset, so the action Box is unbounded and no finite action bound can be sourced, which leaves SAFE-014 with nothing to probe and awards CL2 instead of CL3. There are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. No catalogue requests: only cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used. gate.digest is the digest the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
